title: Brand Manager Ambrosia
description:
At Premier Foods, we're proud to be home to some of the UK's most loved food brands. We're now looking for an experienced Brand Manager to take ownership of Ambrosia, a £118m brand enjoyed by millions of households across the UK and help shape its next chapter of growth.

The Role

As Brand Manager for Ambrosia, you'll lead the delivery of brand growth plans, innovation projects, packaging and communication initiatives, ensuring the brand continues to delight consumers while delivering strong commercial results. You'll work closely with cross-functional teams across Sales, Finance, R&D, Operations and Category to bring exciting ideas to life and drive performance.

What you will be doing:
- Owning brand performance, analysing market trends and identifying growth opportunities
- Leading innovation and product extension projects from concept through to launch
- Delivering shopper marketing, social media and in-store activation campaigns
- Supporting the development of annual and longer-term brand strategies
- Managing marketing budgets and ensuring strong ROI
- Building compelling retailer sell-in stories alongside commercial teams
- Influencing stakeholders across the business to deliver successful outcomes

What we need from you:

We're looking for a commercially minded marketer with:
- Previous brand management experience within FMCG or a similar consumer-focused environment
- Strong project management skills and a track record of delivering results
- Excellent analytical and commercial awareness
- The ability to turn consumer and market insights into action
- Experience working cross-functionally and influencing stakeholders at all levels
- A collaborative approach and passion for building great brands

What we offer you in return:
- Competitive salary and bonus
- Car allowance
- Up to 7.5% pension
- Private medical insurance and life assurance
- Hybrid working (50% home / 50% office or site)
- Sharesave scheme and the option to purchase additional holiday
- Extensive learning and development opportunities
- Access to a wide employee discount scheme

title: Content and Social Media Executive
description:
Challenger brands will never succeed when they're just copying what the rest of the market does, regurgitating the same old proposition and making the same promises. For the new kid on the block to make an impact, they need to do something differently. The company we're partnering with on this exclusive role have done just that and managed to carve themselves (and own) a unique niche in a massively congested market. They've built their brand around a couple of key pillars - sustainability and great customer service - and have reached a stage of their development where they need someone dedicated to capturing and communicating the essence of their brand through social channels.

The Content and Social Media Executive is a newly created role with carte blanche to help push the firm's social engagement to the next level and make it an even stronger customer acquisition channel - along with the ongoing storytelling aspect. The company has nurtured an agile, energetic environment where good ideas are welcomed and people are encouraged to get on with making them happen - so for the right person, that means plenty to work with: an established and growing brand, interesting stories, passionate people and an audience that's ready to hear more from it.

The Role - Content & Social Media Executive

This is definitely not a role for someone who wants to be handed a completed content calendar and a folder marked "approved assets": you'll be expected to bring ideas with you, learn how to frame them in order to get buy-in across the business and then showcase their success. Working closely with the Head of Marketing and people across the business you'll help shape what the brand talks about, how it talks about it and increasingly have influence into where those conversations happen. You'll create social content, write copy, produce visuals, film and edit short-form video and uncover stories from around the business that deserve an audience. If you're confident presenting on screen then that's certainly another string to your bow that will be useful.

You'll need to be one of social media's biggest champions internally. You'll need the confidence and energy to get people across the business involved - maybe dragging Paul from accounts out to help you with a reel - and explain what makes good social content whilst persuading colleagues to share their stories, opinions, expertise and moments that can bring the brand to life.

Key Responsibilities - Content & Social Media Executive
- Generate original content ideas that support the brand, customer engagement and commercial objectives.
- Plan content calendars and campaigns across social media, website and digital channels.
- Champion social media throughout the organisation and encourage colleagues to get involved.
- Seek out stories, opinions and expertise from across the business and turn them into engaging content.
- Create visual content using Canva and other creative tools.
- Film, edit and produce short-form video including Reels, Shorts and TikTok-style content.
- Write social-first copy alongside blogs and other website content.
- Spot opportunities around trends, industry developments and seasonal events without feeling obliged to jump on every bandwagon with a hashtag attached.
- Help create B2 B content including guides, educational resources and thought leadership.
- Produce assets to support LinkedIn activity, partnerships and sales outreach.
- Create and adapt content for digital advertising across social, Google and other channels.
- Engage with customers and followers, responding to comments, messages and enquiries in a way that reflects the company's reputation for excellent customer service.
- Monitor performance and use the results to make the next piece of content better.
- Help build an engaged community around the brand, sustainability and renewable energy.

About You - Content & Social Media Executive

We're looking for someone with ideas. Lots of them. Good ones, bad ones, really awful ones - it doesn't matter. As long as there are some good ones. Or even better, great ones. You could be fresh out of university, or still relatively early in your marketing career, but you'll already be creating good content and you'll have a portfolio that shows us what you can do. You'll understand social media beyond simply knowing where the buttons are and you'll have a feel for what makes people stop, watch, read, comment or share and be able to apply that to the environment this business operates in.

You'll ideally bring:
- Experience creating engaging content for social media.
- Strong Canva skills and a good eye for visual communication.
- Experience filming and editing video.
- Excellent copywriting and written communication skills.
- Strong creative instincts and plenty of ideas.
- The confidence to champion social media internally.
- A good understanding of current platforms, trends and content formats.
- The energy to thrive in an agile, fast-moving environment.
- Strong organisation skills and the ability to manage several projects at once.
- A genuine interest in sustainability and environmental issues.

Experience with Meta, LinkedIn, Google Ads, photography, SEO or website content management would all be useful additions. Above everything else, you'll be curious, proactive and full of energy. You'll enjoy finding stories rather than waiting for them to land in your inbox and you'll be comfortable putting forward an idea, explaining why you think it'll work and then getting on with making it happen. You'll be joining a an amazing business with a strong story, an enviable reputation for customer service and ambitious plans for what comes next - and you'll have a pretty big say in how that story gets told.

title: EMEA Marketing Coordinator
description:
Evolve are partnering with a leading pharmaceutical organisation who are seeking an EMEA Marketing Coordinator to join their Specialist Care team. This is an exciting opportunity to support the delivery of regional marketing activity across Oncology and Neurology, working closely with EMEA Marketing teams and a wide range of internal and external stakeholders.

The role will play a key part in coordinating marketing projects, customer-facing events and presence at major international congresses, ensuring activities are delivered efficiently, compliantly and to a high standard.

This is a full-time, permanent position based at our client's head office in Hertfordshire. Hybrid working is available, offering 3 days in the office and 2 days from home. International travel will also be required as part of the role.

What's in it for you?
- International Exposure - Work across EMEA markets and support high-profile international congresses and customer-facing events.
- Pharmaceutical Experience - Gain valuable exposure to Specialist Care marketing across Oncology and Neurology within an established pharmaceutical organisation.
- Varied & Collaborative Role - Work closely with Marketing, Finance, Legal, Procurement, agencies and healthcare professionals across multiple projects.

Ideal Requirements for the EMEA Marketing Coordinator
- Previous pharmaceutical industry experience, ideally within a regional or EMEA marketing environment, with an understanding of working across multiple markets and cultures.
- Proven experience coordinating meetings, conferences, exhibitions or events, ideally involving medium to large-scale or international activity.
- Strong project coordination and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, stakeholders and competing deadlines simultaneously.
- Experience with Veeva PromoMats, with an understanding of the importance of compliance and approval processes within pharmaceutical marketing.
- Good financial and budget management experience, including managing project expenses, purchase orders and budget tracking.

Role Responsibilities for the EMEA Marketing Coordinator
- Support EMEA marketing activity by coordinating the delivery of Specialist Care marketing projects, ensuring materials and activities are delivered accurately, compliantly and on time.
- Coordinate customer-facing events including advisory boards and speaker meetings, managing logistics, procurement, contracts, compliance requirements and communication with external stakeholders.
- Support international congress activity by coordinating logistics, meetings, materials and on-site marketing activity at key industry events.
- Manage project administration and budgets by maintaining trackers, coordinating purchase orders, supporting financial approvals and ensuring marketing expenditure remains within agreed budgets.
- Coordinate marketing materials and approvals through Veeva PromoMats, ensuring relevant internal processes and compliance requirements are followed.
- Support successful on-site delivery of international meetings and congresses, including international travel where required.

Recruitment Process

2 stage interview process

Meet an amazing team and get your chance to join a company where you can build your pharmaceutical marketing experience, gain international exposure and play a key role in delivering high-profile EMEA activity.

Excited to learn more? Click apply or reach out to the Pharmaceutical recruitment team for full details!

Application Process

Evolve Selection acts as a recruitment partner on behalf of our clients. All applications are reviewed by our specialist consultants and assessed against the specific requirements of the role. Suitable candidates will be contacted for an initial discussion before being introduced to the hiring client.

We appreciate every application; however, due to application volumes, we may not be able to respond to all candidates individually. If you have not heard from us within 3 working days, please consider your application unsuccessful for this particular role, however we may contact you regarding future opportunities that match your experience in line with our privacy policy.

Evolve is a leading recruitment and outsourcing organisation, operating within the Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, Medical Device and Life Science sectors.

Equal opportunities are important to us. We believe that diversity and inclusion are critical to our success as a company. We encourage applications from everyone, regardless of background, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, ethnicity, belief, age, family or parental status, and any other characteristic.

title: Marketing Co-ordinator
description:
Marketing Coordinator - Hertfordshire

Hemel Hempstead

£32,000 - £35,000 + Bonus

Some marketing jobs are about keeping the wheels turning. This one gives you the chance to have a say in which direction they should be heading, too.

We're working on a retained basis with an established and growing business that is primarily B2 B with an element of consumer activity. They work with some seriously impressive technology brands and support high-profile customers with specialist equipment and solutions. They're now looking for a Marketing Coordinator who can keep campaigns moving, projects organised and deadlines under control, while also wanting to understand whether all that marketing activity is actually working.

The Role - Marketing Coordinator

You'll take ownership of the marketing plan, coordinating campaigns across different teams, stakeholders and external partners and making sure everyone has what they need to deliver. There will be plenty happening at once, so a big part of the role is keeping activity moving, deadlines on track and the various people involved pointing in roughly the same direction.

But this isn't just a case of ticking things off a marketing calendar. You'll be looking at the numbers too, monitoring KPIs, analysing campaign performance and ROI and working out what landed, what didn't and what could be done better next time. You'll also have the opportunity to contribute ideas and help shape future activity. If you spot an opportunity or think something could work better, they'll want to hear it.

Key Responsibilities - Marketing Coordinator
- Coordinating and delivering marketing campaigns and projects.
- Managing marketing plans, calendars, deadlines and activity schedules.
- Working with internal stakeholders and external partners to ensure campaigns are delivered effectively.
- Monitoring campaign performance, engagement and ROI.
- Collating and presenting marketing metrics and performance data.
- Identifying trends, opportunities and areas for improvement.
- Supporting the development of longer-term marketing strategy.
- Establishing and monitoring relevant marketing KPIs.
- Preparing reports and presentations for senior stakeholders and brand partners.

About You - Marketing Coordinator

You'll be organised, commercially aware and comfortable taking responsibility for getting things done. There will be multiple campaigns, deadlines and stakeholders competing for your attention, so you'll need to keep on top of the detail without losing sight of why you're doing it in the first place.

You'll also be comfortable with data. You don't need to be someone who dreams about spreadsheets, but you should want to know whether a campaign actually delivered rather than simply being pleased that it went live on time. Strong written communication skills, attention to detail and the confidence to put forward your own ideas will all be important. This is a role with a lot of responsibility, yet also the scope to grow with the business and own the marketing function.

Ideally, you'll have experience of:
- Coordinating and delivering marketing campaigns.
- Using marketing data and analytics to measure performance.
- Managing multiple projects, deadlines and stakeholders.
- Producing marketing reports and presenting results.
- Supporting wider marketing strategy and planning.
- Working independently and using your initiative to improve marketing activity.

The role is predominantly office-based, although there will be times when you'll visit customers, events and exhibitions, so a full UK driving licence is required. Based in Hemel Hempstead, the office is commutable from St Albans, Watford, Welwyn Garden City, Potters Bar, Luton, Hatfield, Ruislip and Beaconsfield.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Marketing Manager - Automotive Aftermarket

Letchworth, Hertfordshire

£43,000 - £48,000 + 10% Bonus + 7% Employer Pension + Private Healthcare + Excellent Benefits

Love cars, understand what makes automotive enthusiasts engage with a brand and want the freedom to shape a European marketing strategy rather than simply execute somebody else's?

This is an opportunity to take ownership of European marketing for a rapidly growing global automotive technology business operating at the heart of the performance, tuning, diagnostics and calibration market.

You'll have genuine autonomy to develop the strategy, create campaigns, shape content and decide how the brand engages with tuners, dealers and automotive enthusiasts across Europe.

And this isn't a marketing role where you'll spend your life briefing agencies from behind a desk.

You'll be close to the cars, customers and content, from dealer visits and product launches to race events, video shoots, influencers and social media.

If you're commercially minded, creative and genuinely passionate about cars, this could be a fantastic role to make your own.

Why Apply?
- £43,000 - £48,000 basic salary, with flexibility for exceptional experience
- Annual bonus potential of 10%
- 7% employer pension contribution
- AXA private healthcare after probation
- Life assurance at 4x salary after probation
- 22 days holiday plus 8 bank holidays
- Significant autonomy over European marketing strategy
- Work within the automotive performance and tuning industry
- Opportunity to influence the growth of a rapidly expanding global automotive technology business
- International exposure and travel
- Work alongside a passionate automotive team

The Opportunity

You'll report directly to the Director of European Operations and take responsibility for how the business markets itself across Europe.

Your objective is straightforward: increase brand awareness, engage the right automotive audiences and help drive sales growth.

You'll own the European marketing strategy and budget, but you'll also remain close to delivery.

That means developing campaigns, directing content, overseeing social media, managing paid advertising, supporting product launches, working with influencers, attending automotive events and making sure marketing activity translates into commercial results.

Content & Social Media

Content is a major part of this role.

You'll lead the social media strategy and manage the Social Media Coordinator, providing the ideas, direction and commercial thinking behind the content being produced.

You'll therefore need to understand the whole content creation process, not simply how to post on social media.

Digital Marketing

You'll also take responsibility for the wider digital journey.

That includes developing paid advertising campaigns across Meta platforms, defining audiences and messaging, monitoring performance and creating landing pages that convert interest into enquiries and sales.

You'll work with the wider international web team to develop the European website, monitor performance through Google Analytics and identify improvements in customer engagement and conversion.

Influencers, Events & the Automotive Community

This is where your genuine interest in cars becomes particularly important.

You'll identify relevant automotive influencers, negotiate partnerships and develop campaigns that put the brand in front of the right audiences.

You'll also plan and attend car shows, race events and other industry activities across Europe, overseeing everything from logistics and branding to networking and content capture.

Working With Sales

Marketing and sales won't operate in separate worlds.

You'll work closely with the European sales team, using customer feedback and commercial priorities to influence campaigns and content.

What We're Looking For

There are two things that are particularly important.

You need to understand the automotive aftermarket or tuning industry. And you need to genuinely love cars.

You'll be creating content for people who understand tuning, performance and vehicle technology, so you'll need the interest and credibility to understand what will resonate with them.

You'll also need:
- Strong experience developing and executing marketing strategy
- Excellent knowledge of social media and content creation
- Experience of storyboarding, scripting, filming and editing
- The ability to conceptualise and direct creative campaigns
- Paid social experience, particularly Meta
- Google Analytics experience
- Adobe Creative Suite knowledge
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Excellent organisational and project management skills
- Confidence managing multiple campaigns and priorities
- A creative, inquisitive and commercially minded approach

Additional European language skills would be advantageous.

Where Will You Work?

Ideally, you'll be based at the European office in Letchworth, Hertfordshire.

However, there is some flexibility for an exceptional UK candidate who cannot relocate, with hybrid working considered on the basis of a minimum three days per week in the Letchworth office.

Why Consider It?

This is a chance to combine a professional marketing career with a genuine automotive passion.

You won't simply inherit a calendar of campaigns and be asked to keep them running.

You'll have the autonomy to decide how the brand grows its European presence, which audiences it targets, what content it creates and how marketing can contribute directly to sales.

If cars are what you talk about outside work as well as something you understand professionally, this could be exactly the sort of marketing role you've been looking for.

Apply today, and Stewart Lupton at JSL Solutions, specialist in industrial and automotive aftermarket recruitment, will be in touch. Alternatively, call Stewart for further information.

JSL Solutions - Recruitment The Right Way.

Specialists in senior commercial and leadership recruitment for manufacturers and distributors across the automotive and industrial aftermarket.

title: Senior Brand Manager - QMS
